messages:
lina: FYI noticing webinar leads piling in but a subset stuck unassigned for ~90s. saw this after 11:03 PT ramp. anyone on revops side?
omar: same. appears to happen when hs enrichment endpoint responds slowly and our RR slot expires, so lead never gets default-owner fallback.
jay: we saw a similar race last quarter but that was sf-mapper TTL mismatch. can you dump the webhook logs?
lina: pasted minimal trace: 
```
POST /integrations/hubspot/enrich  -> 502 after 28s
headers: { 'x-hs-workflow': 'wf-live-webinar-3', 'retry-after': '4' }
round_robin_attempts: 1
assigned: null
```
vivian: weird — our RR code waits 30s for enrichment by default. if webhook returns 502 then we retry enrichment but RR slot has already moved on. leads leak into unowned queue.
jay: proposal: two quick mitigations: 1) shorten RR preflight window to 8s for tags [webinar, partnership, demo] so we don't block routing; 2) add "enrichment_pending" fallback that claims to default-owner after 10s while preserving enrichment state. we can annotate lead.hand_off_reason for audit.
olivia: (ops-bot) ops-bot: can we also throttle enrichment retries to linear 2s x 3 to avoid downstream bursts? :robot_face:
omar: yes please. also add telemetry counter for fallback assignments: metrics.leads.fallback.enrichment_pending. we need to see how often this fires before we change thresholds.
lina: we should also update the playbook prose for SDRs: if lead.hand_off_reason == enrichment_pending and enrichment arrives within 5m, requeue to original owner via hs backfill workflow. add a visible tag "requeued_after_enrich" for reporting.
jay: agree. add a canary rollout: 5% of webinar leads for 30m in us-west1. ops-bot, schedule canary?
ops-bot: deploy-plan created: canary -> 5% marketing traffic us-west1 -> metric gates: fallback_rate < 2% and hand_off_latency 95p < 20s -> promote after 30m. ci-id: ci-7894.
vivian: also flag: SF contact mapping sometimes fails when enrichment changes email casing; add normalize_email lowercasing step in hs->sf mapper to avoid duplicate contact creation.
revops-bot: noted. created ticket REV-4523 for hs workflow wf-live-webinar-3 healthcheck + retries. assigned to @omar.
omar: starting with a small hs workflow backoff change + RR tweak. will post logs in this thread.
lina: thanks — once we confirm metrics good, I'll update the inbound handoff SLA doc and the webinar launch checklist (call out new enrichment gate behaviors).
jay: one more: add an alert: slack #marketing oncall if leads.unowned > 50 for 10m. otherwise ops will miss outage during promo spikes.
ops-bot: alert rule created: leads.unowned > 50 for 10m -> notify marketing oncall. rule id: alert-7733.
lina: saving notes here for post-mortem and playbook. will run a quick retro after the canary window. :thumbsup:
